sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite atlas for a softly hand-painted travel jigsaw. Five independently painted watercolor/gouache cutouts, TRUE transparent RGBA with empty alpha between subjects. Landscape1536x1024, three columns/two rows, bottom-right cell completely empty. Very wide transparent gutters, each COMPLETE subject centered inside own cell, maxheight400, no touching borders or crossing cells. Do not paint background/halo/grid/checkerboard/stickers/text. Natural subtly textured paint, gentle upper-left daylight, no hard outlines. Subjects in cell order: A golden yellow canal lane: TOP LEFT gold-and-ivory triangular cloth pennant with tiny TOP CENTER hanging loop; TOP MIDDLE small magenta geranium cluster on thin bottom stem; TOP RIGHT short narrow cream curtain panel with top hanging loops, full length visible; BOTTOM LEFT small sage leaf sprig with bottom cut stem; BOTTOM MIDDLE delicate pale-white horizontal cloud. No window/pot/sky.
